paper.authors: Michael T. Cox and Anita Raja (eds.)
paper.title: Metareasoning: Thinking about Thinking
paper.section: Ch. 1 — the meta-level monitors object-level reasoners, detects conflicts among their conclusions, and arbitrates control
paper.claim: Given two object-level reasoners producing contradictory conclusions on the same decision key, the meta-level must detect the conflict (naming both reasoners) and resolve via confidence-weighted arbitration.
